text: Hi, Polly! This is my cap.
He's Li Dong. He's my classmate.
My New Year cards are ready.
This is for Sam. He is my brother.
This is for Miss White. She is my teacher.
This is for Chen Jie. She is my classmate. She is my friend too.
This is for Sarah. She is my classmate. She is my friend too.
One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten.
I see number 7. I see two bananas.
I see "L". I see two pencils.
It's OK. Let's use our hands.
A green hand, a red hand, a yellow hand, a blue hand.
I can clean the floor. Oops!
I feel love. I give love too.
I have a car. It's red.
I have a doll. It's orange.
I have a new book. Let's read.
OK. I put my doll and ball away.
I take out my book and pencils.
Now I put my book and pencils away.
I have so many toys. A yellow boat, a blue ball and a red car.
